name: optic atrophy
definition: A disorder characterized by loss of optic nerve fibers. It may be inherited or acquired. Acquired causes include ischemia, optic nerve neuropathy, glaucoma, trauma, radiation, brain tumors, and multiple sclerosis. It leads to vision disturbances.

name: seminal vesicle cystadenoma
definition: A rare benign cystadenoma that arises from the seminal vesicle.

name: rete ovarii cystadenoma
definition: An exceptionally rare cystadenoma that arises from the rete ovarii.

name: uterine ligament papillary cystadenoma associated with von Hippel-Lindau disease
synonyms: uterine ligament papillary cystadenoma associated with von Hippel-Lindau disease
definition: A benign mesonephric neoplasm that arises from the uterine ligament and occurs in women with von Hippel-Lindau disease. It is a cystic lesion characterized by the presence of multiple papillary excrescences.

name: uterine ligament cancer
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the uterine ligament.

name: intravenous leiomyomatosis
definition: A rare benign neoplasm characterized by the presence of smooth muscle cells growing within veins.

name: nerve compression syndrome
definition: Any nerve disorder caused by the entrapment and compression of a nerve.

name: salpingitis isthmica nodosa
definition: Formation of nodules in the isthmus of the fallopian tube due to fallopian tube diverticulosis. It may cause infertility or ectopic pregnancy.

name: chronic salpingitis
definition: Chronic inflammation of the fallopian tube. It usually follows an acute inflammatory attack.

name: pyosalpinx
definition: The presence of pus in the fallopian tube. It is usually caused by acute salpingitis. The fallopian tube is distended and filled with pus. Histologic examination reveals edema and acute and chronic inflammation. Symptoms include fever, vaginal discharge, and pelvic pain.

name: salpingitis
definition: Acute or chronic inflammation of the fallopian tube. It is most often caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae and Chlamydia trachomatis infections. The infections usually originate in the vagina and ascend to the fallopian tube. Symptoms include abdominal, pelvic, and lower back pain, pain during ovulation and sexual intercourse, fever, nausea, and vomiting. Complications include infertility and ectopic pregnancy.

name: uterine ligament serous adenocarcinoma

name: rheumatic pulmonary valve disease

It is characterized by the presence of cysts and is composed of glycogen-rich malignant epithelial cells which produce a watery fluid. Signs and symptoms include upper gastrointestinal bleeding, weight loss, jaundice, and abdominal pain.

name: cervical serous adenocarcinoma
definition: A rare adenocarcinoma that arises from the cervix. It is characterized by the presence of papillary patterns and cellular budding. Psammoma bodies are often seen.

name: endocervicitis
definition: Inflammation of the endocervix.

name: malignant mesenchymoma

name: sebaceous breast carcinoma

definition: A carcinoma that arises from the vulva. It is characterized by the presence of malignant basaloid glandular epithelial cells that resemble sebaceous epithelium and are arranged in cords and nests.

name: clear cell-sugar-tumor of the lung
definition: A rare benign lung tumor with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation. It is composed of round or oval cells with abundant clear or eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders. The vast majority of patients are asymptomatic and the tumors are discovered incidentally. Excision is curative.
grandparents: neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation

name: lung meningioma
definition: A primary or metastatic meningioma that is present in the lung. The lung is the most frequent site of metastasis of meningiomas.

name: lung hilum neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from the hilar region of the lung.

name: verruciform xanthoma of skin
definition: A rare, benign wart-like skin lesion of unknown etiology that is usually found in the genital or perianal area and consists of hyperkeratosis and aggregates of foam cell macrophages.

name: central nervous system hematopoietic neoplasm
synonyms: central nervous system haematopoietic and lymphoid system neoplasm
central nervous system hematopoietic and lymphoid system neoplasm

name: giant hemangioma
definition: A cavernous hemangioma characterized by the presence of hylanized vascular channels and is often associated with the presence of calcifications, fibrosis, and hemorrhage.

name: cavernous hemangioma of colon
definition: A cavernous hemangioma arising from the colon.

name: cavernous hemangioma of face
definition: A cavernous hemangioma arising from the face.

name: rectum neuroendocrine neoplasm
definition: A neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the rectum. It includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

name: tympanic membrane disorder

definition: A disease involving the tympanic membrane.

name: esophageal neuroendocrine tumor

name: mixed hepatoblastoma
definition: A hepatoblastoma characterized by the presence of fetal and embryonal epithelial components and a mesenchymal component.

name: acute urate nephropathy
definition: Urolithiasis in which the composition of the stones is predominantly urate.

name: childhood parosteal osteosarcoma
definition: A low grade malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the surface of the bone. It occurs in childhood and usually affects the distal posterior femur, the proximal tibia, and proximal humerus. Painless swelling is the usual clinical sign. The prognosis is usually excellent.

name: cerebral lymphoma
definition: A non-Hodgkin or Hodgkin lymphoma that arises in the cerebral hemispheres as a primary lesion.

name: hemoglobinuria
definition: A laboratory test result which indicates free hemoglobin in the urine.

name: breast lymphoma
definition: A lymphoma that arises from the breast. There is no history of extramammary breast lymphoma and ipsilateral axillary lymph node involvement does not exclude the diagnosis of primary breast lymphoma. Most patients present with a painless breast lump. The vast majority of cases are B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphomas. Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, follicular lymphoma, and extranodal marginal zone B-cell lymphoma of mucosa associated lymphoid tissue are the most common types of primary non-Hodgkin lymphoma of the breast. Primary Hodgkin lymphoma of the breast is rare.

name: uterine ligament endometrioid adenocarcinoma
definition: A rare endometrioid adenocarcinoma that arises from the uterine ligament. Some of the reported cases were associated with endometriosis.

name: hemolytic anemia
definition: Anemia resulting from the premature destruction of the peripheral blood red cells. It may be congenital or it may be caused by infections, medications, or malignancies.

name: cervical endometrioid adenocarcinoma

endometrioid carcinoma of the fallopian tube

name: testicular seminoma
synonyms: seminomatous germ cell tumor of testis
seminomatous germ cell tumour of testis
definition: A malignant germ cell tumor arising from the testis. It is believed that it is derived from the sexually undifferentiated embryonic gonad. Treatment with radiotherapy is highly successful when the tumor is diagnosed in localized stages, which represents the majority of presentations of seminoma.

name: posterolateral myocardial infarction

name: inferolateral myocardial infarct

name: silent myocardial infarction

name: periosteal chondrosarcoma
definition: A chondrosarcoma arising from the surface of bone. It is characterized by a lobulated growth pattern, high mitotic activity, myxoid stroma formation, and necrotic changes. It occurs in adults. Clinical presentation includes pain, and sometimes swelling.

name: myxoid chondrosarcoma

name: localized chondrosarcoma
definition: A non-disseminated skeletal or extraskeletal chondrosarcoma.

name: clear cell chondrosarcoma

name: apocrine sweat gland neoplasm

name: endocardium cancer

name: well differentiated papillary mesothelioma
synonyms: well-differentiated papillary neoplasm of the mesothelium

It is characterized by the formation of papillae, covered by a single layer of blunt mesothelial cells. Mitotic figures are not present. There is no evidence of severe cytologic atypia. It has a relatively favorable clinical outcome, compared to malignant mesothelioma.

name: bladder urachal carcinoma
definition: Urachal cancer is a type of bladder cancer, making up less than 1% of all bladder cancers. The urachus is a structure normally only present during development in the womb that connects the bellybutton and the bladder. This connection normally disappears before birth, but in some people remains. Urachalcancers are usually diagnosed in adults in their 50's and 60's and may develop at the dome or anterior wall of the bladder, along the midline of the body (including the belly button), and between the pubis symphasis and the bladder.Most urachal cancersare adenocarcinomas (cancers that develop from gland cells).Others may besarcomas (which develop from connective tissue -such as leiomyosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and malignant fibrous histiocytoma), small cell carcinomas, transitional cell cancer, and mixed neoplasias. Most individuals with urachal cancer have symptoms of with hematuria (blood in urine). Other symptoms may include abdominal pain, a palpable abdominal mass, mucinuria, and bacteriuria. Treatment usually involved surgery to remove the cancer.

name: selective IgE deficiency disease
definition: A rare dysgammaglobulinemia characterized by low or undetectable serum levels of immunoglobulin class E (IgE). It is an uncommon primary antibody deficiency. It is most likely an inherited immunodeficiency. It may be caused by decreased or inefficient class-switching from progenitor B cells without any corresponding decreases in the other isotypes. Most affected persons appear asymptomatic but may show a predisposition to autoimmune and respiratory diseases.

name: selective immunoglobulin deficiency disease

Deficiencies of immunoglobulins present variably according to isotype. Selective deficiencies may be caused by decreased or inefficient production from progenitor B cells without any corresponding decreases in the other isotypes. The clinical course and prognosis is dependent upon the severity of the selective deficiency and associated morbidity.

name: Brown-Sequard syndrome
definition: Brown-Sequard syndrome is a rare neurological condition that results from an injury or damage to one side of the spinal cord. This condition results in weakness or paralysis on one side of the body (hemiparaplegia) and a loss of sensation on the opposite side (hemianesthesia). Brown-Sequard syndrome most commonly occurs in the the thoracic spine (upper and middle back). There are several causes of Brown-Sequard syndrome, including: a spinal cord tumor, trauma (such as a puncture wound to the neck or back), infectious or inflammatory diseases (tuberculosis or multiple sclerosis), and disk herniation. Treatment for this condition varies depending on the underlying cause.

Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of small malignant cells, necrosis, and a high mitotic rate. Signs and symptoms include jaundice, abdominal pain, anorexia, nausea, vomiting, and weight loss.
parents: carcinoma of the ampulla of vater

name: cystitis cystica
definition: A reactive inflammatory disorder affecting the bladder. It is characterized by the development of small cysts in the bladder wall. The cysts are lined by urothelial cells.

name: Bartholin gland small cell carcinoma
synonyms: major vestibular gland small cell carcinoma
small cell carcinoma of major vestibular gland
definition: A rare neuroendocrine carcinoma that arises from the Bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells and high mitotic activity.

name: thymus small cell carcinoma
synonyms: small cell carcinoma of the Thymus
thymic small cell carcinoma neuroendocrine type
definition: An aggressive, small cell, poorly differentiated thymic neuroendocrine carcinoma, characterized by the presence of a high mitotic rate and numerous apoptotic bodies.

name: prostate stromal sarcoma
definition: A rare malignant neoplasm arising from specialized prostatic stroma. It is characterized by the presence of stromal overgrowth and hypercellularity, increased number of mitotic figures, and pleomorphism.

name: rectum leiomyoma
definition: A well-circumscribed benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the rectum. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

name: thyroiditis
definition: Inflammation of the thyroid gland. This category includes Hashimoto thyroiditis, Riedel thyroiditis, acute thyroiditis, subacute thyroiditis, and radiation-induced thyroiditis.
grandparents: disease by developmental or physiological process

name: lung occult adenocarcinoma
definition: A lung adenocarcinoma detectable by sputum cytology only. The primary tumor is undetectable radiographically or during bronchoscopy; therefore, it can not be assessed.

name: lung occult large cell carcinoma
synonyms: occult large cell carcinoma of the lung
definition: A large cell lung carcinoma detectable by sputum cytology only. The primary tumor is undetectable radiographically or during bronchoscopy; therefore, it can not be assessed.

name: cloacogenic carcinoma
definition: An anal carcinoma arising from the transitional zone of the anal canal.

name: anus basaloid carcinoma
definition: An anal squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and peripheral nuclear palisading.

name: anal verrucous carcinoma
definition: A large, well differentiated squamous cell carcinoma with a cauliflower-like appearance, characterized by the presence of an exophytic and endophytic growth pattern. Morphologically, there is papillomatosis and acanthosis present, however cytologically the neoplastic squamous cells have a benign appearance. Dysplastic changes are minimal. It does not respond to conservative treatment and it is regarded by many authors as an intermediate lesion between condyloma acuminatum and squamous cell carcinoma.

name: anal canal squamous cell carcinoma
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the anal canal
definition: A squamous cell carcinoma arising from the mucosa of the anal canal.

name: pituitary gland mixed eosinophil-basophil adenoma
definition: An epithelial neoplasm of the anterior pituitary gland in which the neoplastic cells stain positive with acidic and basic dyes.

name: subacute lymphocytic thyroiditis
definition: Thyroiditis associated with painless enlargement of the thyroid gland. It occurs more frequently in females and is characterized by alterations between hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism and the eventual return to normal thyroid gland function.

name: ovarian endometrioid cystadenoma
definition: A benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by endometrial-type well-differentiated cells.

name: normocytic anemia
definition: Anemia in which the red blood cell volume is normal.

name: intermediate malignant teratoma
definition: An immature teratoma characterized by the presence of an intermediate amount of undifferentiated tissues.

name: lung combined large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
synonyms: combined large cell lung neuroendocrine carcinoma
combined large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of lung
combined large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the lung
pulmonary combined large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
definition: A subtype of large cell neuroendocrine lung carcinoma characterized by the presence of large neuroendocrine cells in combination with adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, giant cell carcinoma and/ or spindle cell carcinoma.

name: psammomatous meningioma
definition: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the presence of psammoma bodies that predominate over the meningeal cells.

name: fibrous meningioma
definition: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the presence of spindle cells that form bundles in a collagen matrix.

name: meningothelial meningioma
definition: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the presence of tumor cells that form lobules. The tumor cells are generally uniform. Whorls and psammoma bodies are usually not present.

name: transitional meningioma
definition: A WHO grade I meningioma characterized by the coexistence of meningothelial cells and fibrous architectural patterns.

name: noninvasive malignant thymoma
definition: A morphologically malignant thymoma that is entirely confined within the capsule.

name: gallbladder papillary neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
synonyms: gallbladder papillary neoplasm with an associated invasive cancer
gallbladder papillary neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
intracystic papillary neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
definition: An intraluminal papillary neoplasm, usually with high grade intraepithelial neoplasia, that arises from the gallbladder. It is associated with the presence of an invasive carcinoma. The carcinomatous component is usually an adenocarcinoma.

name: breast giant fibroadenoma
definition: A breast fibroadenoma characterized by a very large size. This term has also been used as a synonym for juvenile fibroadenoma by some authors. The latter is characterized by epithelial hyperplasia and an increased stromal cellularity.

name: spinal meninges cancer
synonyms: cancer of meninx of spinal cord
malignant meninx of spinal cord neoplasm
malignant neoplasm of meninx of spinal cord
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the meninx of spinal cord.

name: chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with immunoglobulin heavy chain variable-region gene somatic hypermutation
synonyms: chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with immunoglobulin heavy chain variable-region gene somatic hypermutation
postgerminal center chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma
postgerminal centre chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma
definition: A recently recognized variant of chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (CLL/SLL) expressing somatic hypermutations of the Immunoglobulin heavy chain (IGH) genes. The recognition of this variant alters the belief that CLL/SLL is always derived from a naive, pregerminal center B-cell. The presence of somatic hypermutations of IGH genes occurs in approximately 50% of CLL/SLL cases and implies a postgerminal center, memory origin. Patients with this variant of CLL/SLL have a favorable prognosis, with a reported median survival of more than 24 years.

name: childhood central nervous system embryonal carcinoma
synonyms: childhood central nervous system embryonal carcinoma
childhood embryonal carcinoma of the central nervous system
embryonal carcinoma of childhood central nervous system
embryonal carcinoma of paediatric central nervous system
embryonal carcinoma of pediatric central nervous system
definition: An embryonal carcinoma that arises from the central nervous system and occurs during childhood.
parents: childhood central nervous system germ cell tumor
embryonal carcinoma of the central nervous system
grandparents: central nervous system germ cell tumor

name: adult central nervous system embryonal carcinoma
synonyms: adult central nervous system embryonal carcinoma
adult embryonal carcinoma of the central nervous system
embryonal carcinoma of adult central nervous system
embryonal carcinoma of the adult central nervous system
embryonal carcinoma of the adult CNS
embryonal carcinoma of the central nervous system of adults
definition: A embryonal carcinoma of the central nervous system that occurs in an adult.
parents: adult central nervous system germ cell tumor
embryonal carcinoma of the central nervous system
grandparents: central nervous system germ cell tumor
central nervous system nongerminomatous germ cell tumor

name: pancreatic mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
definition: A mucinous cystadenocarcinoma that involves the pancreas.
children_sample: pancreatic mucinous-cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma

name: pancreatic mucinous-cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
synonyms: pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
pancreatic mucinous-cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
definition: A cystic epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of columnar mucin-producing epithelial cells, ovarian-type stroma formation, and a focal or extensive invasive carcinomatous component.

name: pancreatic non-invasive mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
definition: A non-invasive malignant cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas. It occurs almost exclusively in women. Small tumors are usually found incidentally. Larger tumors usually produce symptoms related to compression of the adjacent structures. It is characterized by the presence of columnar, mucin-producing epithelial cells which often form papillary projections with irregular branching and budding. There is cellular stratification, severe dysplasia, and high mitotic activity present. Complete surgical removal is usually associated with an excellent prognosis.

name: female stress incontinence
definition: The involuntary loss of urine in females secondary to insufficient strength of the pelvic floor muscles; this can result from physical changes following pregnancy and childbirth, or as a response to a decrease in estrogen during menopause.

name: uterine corpus apoplectic leiomyoma
synonyms: uterine corpus leiomyoma with apoplectic change
definition: A morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by zones of hemorrhagic infarction surrounded by hypercellular areas. It usually develops in women of childbearing years, particularly those that are pregnant, post-partum, or taking oral contraceptives.

name: uterine corpus cellular leiomyoma
synonyms: cellular leiomyoma of body of uterus
definition: A morphologic variant of leiomyoma arising from the uterine corpus. It is characterized by a dense cellular infiltrate composed of spindle or round cells with scant cytoplasm and a less obvious interlacing fascicle pattern.

name: bladder urachal urothelial carcinoma
definition: A transitional cell carcinoma of the urinary bladder that arises from the urachal epithelium.

name: lymphoepithelioma-like acinar prostate adenocarcinoma
definition: A variant of prostate carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant cells forming syncytial patterns and dense lymphocytic infiltrates.

name: selective IgD deficiency disease
definition: A rare dysgammaglobulinemia characterized by low or undetectable serum levels of immunoglobulin class D (IgD). It is an uncommon primary antibody deficiency. It is most likely an inherited immunodeficiency. It may be caused by decreased or inefficient production of IgD from progenitor B cells without any corresponding decreases in the other isotypes. Most affected persons are asymptomatic and do not appear to be at increased risk for infection.

name: hereditary fallopian tube carcinoma
definition: Fallopian tube carcinoma that has developed in relatives of patients that have a history of fallopian tube carcinoma.
grandparents: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

name: cribriform variant testicular seminoma
definition: A morphologic variant of testicular seminoma characterized by the presence of seminoma cells arranged in cribriform patterns and few lymphocytes.

name: premenstrual tension
definition: A combination of distressing physical, psychologic, or behavioral changes that occur during the luteal phase of the menstrual cycle. Symptoms of PMS are diverse (such as pain, water-retention, anxiety, cravings, and depression) and they diminish markedly 2 or 3 days after the initiation of menses.

name: uterine corpus adenocarcinofibroma
definition: A adenocarcinofibroma that involves the body of uterus.
grandparents: uterine corpus mixed epithelial and mesenchymal neoplasm

name: adenocarcinoma of skene gland origin
definition: A rare adenocarcinoma arising from Skene gland. It presents as a periurethral or anterior vaginal submucosal mass. It is characterized by morphological features similar to prostate adenocarcinoma.

name: secretory uterine corpus endometrioid adenocarcinoma
definition: An endometrioid adenocarcinoma arising from the endometrium. Morphologically it is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells containing glycogen vacuoles which are usually subnuclear and reminiscent of early secretory endometrium.

name: childhood extraosseous osteosarcoma
definition: An osteosarcoma arising from the soft tissue, and occurring during childhood.

name: benign urethral neoplasm
definition: Abnormal growth of the cells of the urethra (lower urinary tract) without malignant characteristics.

name: testicular yolk sac tumor, endodermal sinus pattern
synonyms: testicular yolk sac tumor, endodermal sinus pattern
related_synonyms: endodermal sinus pattern testicular yolk sac tumour
definition: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of connective tissue stalks that contain a blood vessel and are lined by cells with clear cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli.

name: benign urinary system neoplasm
synonyms: benign neoplasm of the urinary tract
benign tumor of the urinary tract
benign tumour of the urinary tract
definition: A non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the organs that comprise the urinary system. Representative examples include renal oncocytoma, bladder inverted papilloma, and urothelial papilloma.

name: breast adenomyoepithelial adenosis
definition: An uncommon variant of breast adenosis characterized by the presence of irregularly shaped glands, epithelial cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, and prominent myopepithelial cells. Mild atypia may be present.

name: stage IVb bladder cancer
synonyms: Jewett-Marshall stage D2 urinary bladder cancer
Jewett-Marshall stage D2 urinary bladder carcinoma
definition: Stage IV includes T4b, NO,MO/any T NI, MO/ any T N2 MO,/ any T N3 MO/ any T any N M1 : T4b: Tumor invades the pelvic wall, abdominal wall. N1: Metastasis in a single lymph node, 2 cm or less in greatest dimension. N2: Metastasis in a single lymph node, more than 2 cm but not more than 5 cm in greatest dimension; or multiple lymph nodes, none more than 5 cm in greatest dimension. N3: Metastasis in a lymph node more than 5 cm in greatest dimension. M1: Distant metastasis.

name: axonal neuropathy
definition: Any nerve disorder affecting the axon of a nerve.

name: urethral disorder
definition: A disease involving the urethra.
grandparents: disease by body system or component

name: ovarian serous cystadenofibroma
definition: A benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by serous epithelial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

name: cranial nodular fasciitis
definition: A rare self-limiting, rapidly growing, non-encapsulated benign neoplasm that arises from the cranium. This is an osteolytic lesion. It is characterized by the presence of plump spindle-shaped fibroblasts, multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells, chronic inflammatory infiltrate, red blood cell extravasation, and high mitotic activity.

name: nodular fasciitis
definition: A self-limiting, rapidly growing, non-encapsulated benign neoplasm that arises from the soft tissues. It is characterized by the presence of plump spindle-shaped fibroblasts, multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells, chronic inflammatory infiltrate, red blood cell extravasation, and high mitotic activity.

name: iris spindle cell melanoma
synonyms: spindle cell melanoma of the iris
definition: A spindle cell melanoma that involves the iris.

name: esophageal tuberculosis
definition: A tuberculosis that involves the esophagus.

name: nephrogenic adenoma of urinary bladder
synonyms: nephrogenic adenoma of the urinary bladder
definition: A metaplastic lesion of the urothelium found in the urinary bladder. It is characterized by the presence of aggregates of cuboidal or hobnail cells and represents a reaction of the urothelium to injury caused by instrumentation, surgery or calculi.

name: nephrogenic adenoma
definition: So-called nephrogenic adenoma is a distinct metaplastic lesion of the urothelium characterized by aggregates of cuboidal or hobnail cells. These cells line thin papillary fronds on the surface or form tubular structures within the lamina propria.

name: urethra cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the urethra

name: pediatric ovarian dysgerminoma
synonyms: childhood ovarian germinomatous germ cell tumor
childhood ovarian germinomatous germ cell tumour
definition: A dysgerminoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

name: ovarian stromal hyperthecosis
definition: A non-neoplastic disorder that usually affects postmenopausal women. It is characterized by the leuteinization of ovarian stromal cells. The ovaries are bilaterally involved and enlarged. When it affects women in reproductive age, it causes virilization, high blood pressure, and increased insulin levels.

name: thymic dysplasia
definition: The developmental arrest and architectural distortion of the thymus that results in immunodeficiency.

name: rectal sarcomatoid carcinoma
definition: A biphasic rectal carcinoma with a spindle cell, sarcomatoid component.

name: male urethral cancer
definition: A cancer involving a male urethra.

name: testicular yolk sac tumor, solid pattern
synonyms: testicular yolk sac tumor, solid pattern
related_synonyms: solid pattern testicular yolk sac tumour
definition: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of aggregates of polygonal malignant cells with clear cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli.

name: vulvar keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma
definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the presence of keratin pearls.

name: superficial urinary bladder carcinoma
definition: A term used by urologists to describe an infiltrating carcinoma of the bladder that has not invaded into the muscularis propria of the bladder wall regardless of histologic type or grade.

name: pituitary hypoplasia
definition: Incomplete development of the pituitary gland.

name: adrenal medulla carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the adrenal medulla
children_sample: metastatic carcinoma in the adrenal medulla

name: female urethral cancer
definition: A cancer that involves the female urethra.

name: squamous cell skin papilloma
definition: A squamous papilloma that involves the zone of skin.

name: pulmonary vein leiomyosarcoma
definition: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the pulmonary vein. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

name: pulmonary artery leiomyosarcoma
definition: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the pulmonary artery It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

name: superior vena cava leiomyosarcoma
synonyms: leiomyosarcoma of the Superior vena cava
definition: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the superior vena cava. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

name: cerebral primitive neuroectodermal tumor
definition: A central nervous system embryonal tumor, not otherwise specified arising from the cerebral hemispheres.

name: colonic L-cell glucagon-like peptide producing tumor
synonyms: colon L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumor
colon L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumour
colonic L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumor
colonic L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumour
L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumor of colon
L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumour of colon
definition: A neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the colon and produces glucagon-like peptides. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells forming tubular or trabecular patterns.
parents: neuroendocrine tumor of the colon, well differentiated, low or intermediate grade tumor

name: L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumor
definition: A neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the gastrointestinal tract and produces glucagon-like peptides. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells forming tubular or trabecular patterns.
children_sample: colonic L-cell glucagon-like peptide producing tumor
small intestinal L-cell glucagon-like peptide producing tumor

name: vulvar keratoacanthoma-like carcinoma
synonyms: vulvar squamous cell carcinoma, keratoacanthoma type
definition: A rapidly growing squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva. It is self-limited and is characterized by the presence of a central crater that contains squamous cells. The proliferating squamous cells infiltrate the dermis below and produce keratin masses that are pushed towards the surface of the tumor.

name: vulvar non-keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma
definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the absence of keratin pearls.

name: ovarian endometrioid cystadenofibroma
definition: A benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by endometrial-type well-differentiated cells in a fibrotic stroma.

name: cutaneous anthrax
definition: An anthrax disease that results in infection located in skin, has material basis in Bacillus anthracis, which is transmitted by contact with infected animals or animal products. The infection has symptom skin lesion that eventually forms an ulcer with a black center.
parents: skin disease caused by bacterial infection

name: childhood brain germinoma
definition: A germinoma arising from the brain during childhood.
grandparents: childhood central nervous system germ cell tumor

name: childhood germ cell brain tumor
synonyms: germ cell neoplasm of childhood brain
germ cell neoplasm of paediatric brain
definition: A germ cell tumor arising from brain during childhood.
parents: childhood central nervous system germ cell tumor
grandparents: central nervous system germ cell tumor

name: polyvesicular vitelline pattern testicular yolk sac tumor
definition: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of collections of vesicles that are surrounded by connective tissue.

name: endometrial endometrioid adenocarcinoma with spindled epithelial cells
synonyms: endometrial endometrioid adenocarcinoma with spindled epithelial cells
definition: A primary endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium characterized by the presence of spindled malignant epithelial cells.

name: uterine corpus perivascular epithelioid cell tumor
synonyms: body of uterus neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation
uterine corpus perivascular epithelioid cell tumor
definition: A neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation arising from the uterine corpus wall.
parents: mixed endometrial stromal and smooth muscle tumor
neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation

name: ovarian clear cell cystadenocarcinoma
definition: A malignant glandular epithelial neoplasm arising from the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of clear and hobnail cells and cystic structures.

name: polyp of middle ear
definition: A benign polypoid growth in the middle ear.

name: monoclonal gammopathy of uncertain significance
synonyms: monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance (morphologic abnormality)
definition: A condition characterized by the presence of a monoclonal gammopathy (MG) in which the clonal mass has not reached a predefined state in which the condition is considered malignant. Up to 25% of cases of monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance (MGUS) progress to a B-cell malignancy or myeloma. MGUS may occur in conjunction with various carcinomas, chronic inflammatory and infectious conditions, and other diseases.

name: epididymal adenomatoid tumor
definition: A benign, usually asymptomatic small mesothelial tumor that arises from the epididymis.

name: acantholytic variant squamous cell breast carcinoma
synonyms: squamous cell breast carcinoma, acantholytic variant
definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the breast parenchyma and is characterized by cellular discohesion resulting in a pseudoangiosarcomatous pattern.

name: spindle cell variant squamous cell breast carcinoma
synonyms: squamous cell breast carcinoma, spindle cell variant
related_synonyms: metaplastic adenocarcinoma with spindle cell differentiation
definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the breast parenchyma and is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped malignant cells.

name: large cell keratinizing variant squamous cell breast carcinoma
synonyms: squamous cell breast carcinoma, large cell keratinizing variant
definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the breast parenchyma and is characterized by the presence of large malignant cells that exhibit keratinization.

name: childhood pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma
definition: A rare aggressive rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in children. The neoplasm is characterized by the presence of bizarre round, spindle, and polygonal cells.

name: chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK-cells
synonyms: chronic NK-large granular lymphocyte lymphoproliferative disorder
indolent large granular NK-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
definition: An Epstein-Barr virus negative disorder with a chronic clinical course affecting predominantly adults and characterized by the proliferation of large granular lymphocytes with natural killer cell immunophenotype. The T-cell receptor genes are not rearranged.
parents: neoplasm of mature T-cells or NK-cells

name: diverticulitis
definition: An infection that develops in the diverticula of the intestinal tract. Signs and symptoms include abdominal pain, fever, and leukocytosis.
grandparents: disease by developmental or physiological process

name: duodenal somatostatinoma
synonyms: duodenal delta cell somatostatin producing tumour
definition: A somatostatin-producing neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the duodenum. It is characterized by the presence of tubulo-glandular structures.
parents: duodenal neuroendocrine tumor, well differentiated, low or intermediate grade
grandparents: small intestine neuroendocrine tumor, well differentiated, low or intermediate grade

name: large cell carcinoma with rhabdoid phenotype
synonyms: large cell carcinoma with rhabdoid phenotype (morphologic abnormality)
large cell lung carcinoma with rhabdoid phenotype
definition: A rare poorly differentiated morphologic variant of large cell lung carcinoma characterized by the presence of rhabdoid cells.

name: cervical keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma
definition: A variant of cervical squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of keratin pearls. Intercellular bridges and cytoplasmic keratinization are usually present.

name: posterior urethra cancer
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of the posterior urethra
malignant tumor of the posterior urethra
malignant tumour of the posterior urethra
definition: A malignant neoplasm that affects the portion of the urethra that is close to the bladder.

name: Osgood-Schlatter disease
synonyms: aseptic necrosis of the tibial tubercle
definition: Osteochondrosis of the growth plate near the tibial tuberosity.

name: vulvar proximal-type epithelioid sarcoma
definition: An epithelioid sarcoma of the proximal type involving the vulva.

name: proximal-type epithelioid sarcoma
definition: An epithelioid sarcoma predominantly involving the pelvis, perineum, and genital organs. It tends to have a more aggressive clinical course as compared to the more frequently seen distal-type epithelioid sarcoma.

name: ependymal tumor of brain
definition: A tumor arising from the ependymal lining of the ventricles.

name: peptic ulcer disease
synonyms: acute peptic ulcer with haemorrhage and perforation
acute peptic ulcer without haemorrhage and without perforation
definition: A digestive system disease characterized by discontinuation in the inner lining of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract because of gastric acid secretion or pepsin.
grandparents: disease by body system or component
disease by developmental or physiological process

name: pediatric infratentorial ependymoma
definition: An ependymoma that arises from the infratentorial region of the brain and occurs during childhood.

name: pediatric supratentorial ependymoma
definition: An ependymoma that arises from the supratentorial region of the brain and occurs during childhood.

name: extrahepatic bile duct papillary adenoma
synonyms: papillary adenoma of extrahepatic bile duct
papillary adenoma of the extrahepatic bile duct
definition: An adenoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts. It is characterized by the presence of a papillary growth pattern.

name: small intestine neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the small intestine. Representative examples of benign neoplasms include lipoma and leiomyoma. Representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.

name: small intestinal L-cell glucagon-like peptide producing tumor
synonyms: L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumor of small intestine
L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumour of small intestine
small intestinal L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing NET
small intestinal L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumor
small intestinal L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumour
small intestinal L-cell, glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumor
small intestinal L-cell, glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumour
small intestine L-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumor
definition: A neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the small intestine and produces glucagon-like peptides. Morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells forming tubular or trabecular patterns.
parents: small intestine neuroendocrine tumor, well differentiated, low or intermediate grade

name: intraductal breast papillomatosis
definition: A benign breast neoplasm characterized by the proliferation of multiple papillomas within the lumen of the ducts.

name: Wolffian adnexal tumor
synonyms: female adnexal tumor of probable Wolffian origin
female adnexal tumour of probable Wolffian origin
definition: A benign or malignant epithelial neoplasm of probable Wolffian origin. It predominantly arises from the broad ligament and presents as a unilateral adnexal mass.

name: lumbar spinal canal and spinal cord meningioma
synonyms: meningioma of the lumbar spinal canal and spinal cord
definition: A meningioma that arises from the meninges of the lumbar region of the spinal cord.

name: childhood central nervous system mixed germ cell tumor
synonyms: childhood mixed germ cell tumor of central nervous system
childhood mixed germ cell tumour of central nervous system

mixed germ cell tumor of central nervous system

name: female orgasmic disorder
definition: A sexual disorder in which a woman fails to achieve orgasm during sexual intercourse.

name: endocervical carcinoma
definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the endocervix.

name: peptic ulcer perforation
definition: Penetration of a peptic ulcer through the wall of duodenum or stomach allowing the leakage of luminal contents into the peritoneal cavity.

name: periductal breast myoepitheliosis
definition: A neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells around small breast ducts.

name: breast myoepitheliosis
definition: A multifocal neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells within and/or around small breast ducts.

name: pediatric infratentorial ependymoblastoma
synonyms: childhood infratentorial embryonal tumor with Multilayered Rosettes, C19MC-altered
childhood infratentorial embryonal tumour with Multilayered Rosettes, C19MC-altered
definition: An embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered that arises from the infratentorial region and occurs in children.

grandparents: central nervous system primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm
central nervous system Ewing sarcoma/peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor

name: acute endometritis
definition: An acute, usually bacterial infection affecting the endometrium. It is characterized by the presence of neutrophils or microabscesses in the endometrial glands. Symptoms include fever, lower abdominal pain, and vaginal discharge.

name: anal gland adenocarcinoma
definition: An anal adenocarcinoma arising from the epithelium of the anal glands. The overlying anal mucosa does not show evidence of neoplastic changes.

name: breast ductal adenoma
definition: A benign, well circumscribed neoplasm that is located within the lumen of a duct in the breast parenchyma. It is characterized by the presence of glandular structures at the periphery and fibrous tissue at the center of the tumor.

name: pregnancy adenoma
definition: A tubular type adenoma of the breast in which, during pregnancy and lactation, the epithelial cells show extensive secretory changes.

name: urinary bladder tuberculosis
definition: A tuberculosis that involves the urinary bladder.

name: breast apocrine adenoma
definition: A rare, benign and well circumscribed neoplasm that arises from the breast. It is characterized by the proliferation of epithelial cells with extensive apocrine metaplasia.

name: mixed epithelial/mesenchymal metaplastic breast carcinoma
definition: An invasive breast carcinoma characterized by the presence of a mesenchymal cellular component. The mesenchymal cellular component ranges from cartilaginous and osseous, to purely sarcomatous.

name: osteosarcoma arising in bone Paget disease
synonyms: osteosarcoma arising in bone Paget's disease
osteosarcoma arising in osseous Paget's disease
osteosarcoma arising in Paget disease of bone
osteosarcoma arising in Paget's disease of bone
definition: A sarcomatous transformation of pre-existing Paget disease of the bone. Osteosarcomas arising from Paget disease of the bone are high grade lesions and usually have a poor prognosis.

name: ceruminoma
synonyms: ceruminous adenoma of external auditory canal
ceruminous adenoma of the external auditory canal
definition: A benign epithelial neoplasm derived from ceruminous glands in the external auditory canal. It presents as a gray mass covered by skin. It is characterized by a proliferation of glands composed of cells with abundant eosinophilic and granular cytoplasm.

name: gonorrhea
definition: A common sexually transmitted bacterial infection caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae. It is transmitted through vaginal, oral, or anal intercourse. Infected individuals may be asymptomatic. Symptoms in males include burning sensation during urination, discharge from the penis, and painful swelling of the testes. Symptoms in females include painful urination, vaginal discharge, and vaginal bleeding between periods. If untreated, the infection may lead to pelvic inflammatory disease.

name: glossopharyngeal motor neuropathy
synonyms: motor peripheral neuropathy of glossopharyngeal nerve
definition: Diseases of the ninth cranial (glossopharyngeal) nerve or its nuclei in the medulla. The nerve may be injured by diseases affecting the lower brain stem, floor of the posterior fossa, jugular foramen, or the nerve's extracranial course. Clinical manifestations include loss of sensation from the pharynx, decreased salivation, and syncope. Glossopharyngeal neuralgia refers to a condition that features recurrent unilateral sharp pain in the tongue, angle of the jaw, external auditory meatus and throat that may be associated with syncope. Episodes may be triggered by cough, sneeze, swallowing, or pressure on the tragus of the ear. (Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1390)

name: pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm

Grossly, it is characterized by the presence of intraductal masses. Morphologically, there is proliferation of mucin-producing cells within the pancreatic ducts, intraductal accumulation of mucin, and a papillary growth pattern. It may be associated with the presence of an invasive carcinoma. It usually occurs in older patients. Signs and symptoms include epigastric pain, weight loss, jaundice, chronic pancreatitis, and diabetes mellitus.
