name: liver fibrosarcoma
definition: A usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the liver. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

name: ovarian myxoid liposarcoma
definition: A liposarcoma that arises from the ovary and is composed of round to oval mesenchymal cells, small signet ring lipoblasts, and a rich network of capillaries in a myxoid stroma.

name: sporadic breast cancer
definition: A carcinoma that arises from the breast and is not caused by inherited genetic mutations.

name: periocular meningioma
definition: A meningioma that affects the periocular region.

name: pineal region meningioma
definition: A meningioma that affects the pineal gland.

name: childhood ovarian embryonal carcinoma
synonyms: paediatric embryonal carcinoma of the ovary
pediatric embryonal carcinoma of the ovary
definition: An embryonal carcinoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.
grandparents: malignant non-dysgerminomatous germ cell tumor of ovary

name: testis polyembryoma
definition: A rare malignant germ cell tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of embryoid bodies.

name: chest wall parachordoma
definition: A parachordoma arising from the chest wall.

name: bladder tubulo-cystic clear cell adenocarcinoma
definition: A rare morphologic variant of bladder carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells and clear cells forming a tubulo-cystic pattern.

name: bladder papillary clear cell adenocarcinoma
definition: A rare morphologic variant of bladder adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells and clear cells forming a papillary pattern.

name: olfactory groove meningioma
definition: A meningioma that affects the olfactory sulcus.

name: pituitary stalk meningioma
definition: A meningioma that affects the pituitary stalk.

name: frontal sinus inverted papilloma
synonyms: inverted papilloma of the frontal sinus
definition: A benign neoplasm that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the frontal sinus. It results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma.

name: intraductal breast myoepitheliosis
definition: A neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells within small breast ducts.

name: carotid artery occlusion
synonyms: carotid artery segment occlusion precerebral artery
occlusion precerebral artery of carotid artery segment
definition: A occlusion precerebral artery that involves the carotid artery segment.

name: sarcomatous intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
synonyms: intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma with extensive sarcomatous changes
definition: A rare, aggressive variant of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. It is characterized by the presence of adenocarcinoma cells that are intermingled with malignant pleomorphic spindle cells.
grandparents: carcinoma of liver and intrahepatic biliary tract

name: childhood central nervous system germinoma
synonyms: central nervous system germinoma of childhood
definition: A germinoma arising from the central nervous system during childhood.
parents: childhood central nervous system germ cell tumor
grandparents: central nervous system germ cell tumor

name: testicular yolk sac tumor, myxomatous pattern
synonyms: testicular yolk sac tumor, myxomatous pattern
related_synonyms: myxomatous pattern testicular yolk sac tumour
definition: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of myxomatous tissue that contains collections of malignant cells with prominent nucleoli.

name: cellular congenital mesoblastic nephroma
definition: A congenital mesoblastic nephroma characterized by increased cellularity, sheet-like proliferation of fibroblastic cells, and increased mitotic activity. Necrotic changes are commonly present.

name: classic congenital mesoblastic nephroma
definition: A congenital mesoblastic nephroma characterized by the presence of interlacing fascicles of fibroblastic cells, low mitotic activity, and collagen formation.

name: cocaine abuse
definition: Disorders related or resulting from use of cocaine.

name: maxillary sinus Schneiderian papilloma
synonyms: maxillary sinus paranasal sinus Schneiderian papilloma
paranasal sinus Schneiderian papilloma of maxillary sinus
Schneiderian papilloma of the maxillary sinus
definition: A papilloma that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the maxillary sinus. It is classified as inverted papilloma and oncocytic papilloma.

name: bladder hepatoid adenocarcinoma
definition: A hepatoid adenocarcinoma that involves the urinary bladder.

name: thyroid gland fetal adenoma
definition: A thyroid gland adenoma composed of microfollicular structures.

name: vaginal tubulovillous adenoma
definition: An adenoma that arises from the vagina and is characterized by a tubulovillous architectural pattern.

name: extrahepatic bile duct cystadenoma
synonyms: cystadenoma of the extrahepatic bile duct
extrahepatic bile duct mucinous cystic neoplasm
definition: A mucinous cystic neoplasm that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts.

name: cellular phase chronic idiopathic myelofibrosis
definition: Primary myelofibrosis characterized by bone marrow hypercellularity and the presence of atypical megakaryocytes. There is no increase in the percentage of myeloblasts and no significant increase in reticulin or collagen fibrosis in the bone marrow.

name: nephrogenic adenoma of the urethra
definition: A metaplastic lesion of the urothelium found in the urethra. It is characterized by the presence of aggregates of cuboidal or hobnail cells and represents a reaction of the urothelium to injury caused by instrumentation, surgery or calculi.

name: periampullary adenocarcinoma
definition: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the periampullary region.
grandparents: carcinoma of the ampulla of vater

name: neuronitis
grandparents: disease by body system or component
disease by developmental or physiological process

name: mature gastric teratoma
definition: A benign teratoma that arises from the stomach.

name: anal canal Paget disease
synonyms: Paget disease of the anal canal
Paget's disease of the anal canal
definition: Paget disease involving the squamous epithelium of the anal canal.

name: bacterial arthritis
definition: The inflammation of one or more joints caused by a bacterial infection within the joint space. Symptoms include pain, stiffness, and decreased range of motion in the affected joint.

name: breast columnar cell mucinous carcinoma
definition: An invasive breast adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of tall columnar neoplastic cells that contain intracytoplasmic mucin. Grossly, cystic changes are not identified.

name: epiglottis cancer
related_synonyms: malignant neoplasm of anterior aspect of epiglottis
malignant neoplasm of anterior surface of epiglottis
definition: A malignant neoplasm that affects the epiglottis. The vast majority of cases are squamous cell carcinomas.

name: gallbladder lymphoma
definition: A lymphoma that arises from the gallbladder, with the bulk of the tumor located at this site.

name: thymus clear cell carcinoma
synonyms: clear cell carcinoma of the Thymus
definition: A rare, usually aggressive, primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by the presence of carcinoma cells with clear cytoplasm.

name: adrenal gland ganglioneuroblastoma
definition: A ganglioneuroblastoma arising from the adrenal gland.

name: pregerminal center chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma
synonyms: chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with unmutated Immunoglobulin heavy chain variable-region Gene
pregerminal center chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma
definition: A recently recognized variant of chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (CLL/SLL) that lacks somatic hypermutations of the Immunoglobulin heavy chain (IGH) genes, implying pregerminal center B-cell origin. Microarray gene expression profiling studies have demonstrated the expression of ZAP-70 gene (Syk family tyrosine kinase) in this subset of CLL/CLL. Patients with this variant of CLL/SLL have an unfavorable prognosis compared to those with somatic hypermutations of the IGH genes, with a median survival of approximately 6-8 years.

name: pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
synonyms: pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
definition: A pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm characterized by the presence of a focal or multifocal invasive carcinomatous component. The invasive carcinoma is either colloid or ductal adenocarcinoma.

name: fibroosseous pseudotumor of the digits
definition: A non-neoplastic soft tissue disorder characterized by the localized formation of reactive fibrous and bone tissues. It usually occurs in the subcutaneous tissue of the proximal phalanx. Less frequently, it involves the toe. It presents with swelling and pain of the affected area. The prognosis is excellent. However, incomplete excision may lead to the re-growth of the lesion.
grandparents: benign connective and soft tissue neoplasm

name: thyroid gland oncocytic adenoma
definition: A thyroid gland adenoma composed of large cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and large nuclei with prominent nucleoli.

name: gallbladder melanoma
definition: A melanoma that arises from the gallbladder.

name: interstitial myocarditis
definition: Inflammation of the heart characterized by infiltration of the interstitial tissues by inflammatory cells, histiocytes, and the formation of granulomas. Giant cells are often present.

name: endocervical type cervical adenomyoma
definition: An adenomyoma that arises from the cervix and is characterized by the presence of endocervical mucinous glands and a smooth muscle cell component. There is no atypia or significant mitotic activity present.

name: endometrial type cervical adenomyoma
definition: An adenomyoma that arises from the cervix and is characterized by the presence of endometrial type glands and endometrial stroma, surrounded by smooth muscle. There is no evidence of atypia.

name: cervical atypical polypoid adenomyoma
definition: An adenomyoma that arises from the cervix and is characterized by the presence of a glandular component exhibiting architectural complexity.

name: fallopian tube gestational choriocarcinoma
synonyms: gestational choriocarcinoma of the fallopian tube
definition: A malignant trophoblastic tumor that arises from the fallopian tube during pregnancy.

name: uterine corpus choriocarcinoma
synonyms: gestational choriocarcinoma of body of uterus
definition: An aggressive malignant tumor arising from trophoblastic cells in the uterus during pregnancy. Approximately half of the cases develop from a complete hydatidiform mole. There is often marked elevation of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in the blood. Choriocarcinomas disseminate rapidly through the hematogenous route; the lungs are most frequently affected.
parents: malignant germ cell tumor of corpus uteri

name: mediastinitis
definition: An inflammatory process affecting the mediastinum.
grandparents: disease by developmental or physiological process

name: testicular yolk sac tumor, papillary pattern
synonyms: testicular yolk sac tumor, papillary pattern
related_synonyms: papillary pattern testicular yolk sac tumour
definition: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of numerous papillary structures that are lined by cells with prominent nucleoli.

name: testicular yolk sac tumor, hepatoid pattern
synonyms: testicular yolk sac tumor, hepatoid pattern
related_synonyms: hepatoid pattern testicular yolk sac tumour
definition: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of hepatoid cells collections.

name: myotonic cataract
definition: A cataract occurring as a sequela of myotonic dystrophy.

name: myocarditis
definition: Myocarditis is a condition that is characterized by inflammation of the heart muscle (myocardium). Some affected people have no noticeable symptoms of the condition. When present, signs and symptoms may include chest pain, abnormal heartbeat, shortness of breath, fatigue, signs of infection (i.e. fever, headache, sore throat, diarrhea), and leg swelling. Myocarditis can be caused by a variety of factors including infections (viral, bacterial, parasitic, and fungal), allergic reactions to certain medications, and exposure to certain chemicals. It can also be associated with other inflammatory conditions such as lupus, Wegener's granulomatosis, giant cell arteritis and Takayasu's arteritis. Most cases occur sporadically in people with no family history of the condition. Treatment aims to address the underlying cause of the condition. Medications and rarely, a heart transplant may be needed if the heart muscle becomes weak.

name: tertiary syphilis
definition: A stage of syphilis that occurs fifteen to thirty years after the initial infection; it can include gumma formation and cardiovascular or central nervous system involvement (neurosyphilis).

name: sacral spinal canal and spinal cord meningioma
synonyms: meningioma of sacral spinal canal and spinal cord
definition: A meningioma that arises from the meninges of the sacral region of the spinal cord.

name: lung hilum carcinoma
definition: A lung carcinoma arising from the hilum of the lung.

name: lung superior sulcus carcinoma
synonyms: superior sulcus carcinoma of the lung
definition: A carcinoma originating from the apical lung. Most superior sulcus lung carcinomas are bronchogenic carcinomas. This carcinoma may be associated with Pancoast syndrome. lt is also known as Pancoast tumor.

name: fallopian tube cystadenofibroma
definition: A rare, benign, asymptomatic neoplasm that arises from the fallopian tube. The tumors are round and solitary and contain connective tissue and cystic structures lined by serous-type epithelium. The majority of cases are incidental findings during operation for an unrelated gynecologic disorder.

name: upper clivus meningioma
definition: A meningioma that affects the upper clivus.

name: penile urethral cancer
definition: A urethra cancer that involves the penis.

name: central breast papilloma
definition: A benign papillary neoplasm that arises in a large duct of the breast. It is characterized by the presence of a fibrovascular core that is lined by benign epithelial and myoepithelial proliferations. Patients usually present with nipple discharge.

name: microscopic breast papilloma
definition: A benign papillary neoplasm that arises in a terminal ductal lobular unit. It is characterized by the presence of a fibrovascular core that is lined by benign epithelial and myoepithelial proliferations. Peripheral breast papillomas are often multiple and are usually found microscopically. Patients are often asymptomatic.

name: atypical breast papilloma
definition: An intraductal papilloma of the breast characterized by the presence of focal epithelial atypia.

name: periapical periodontitis
definition: Inflammation of the periapical tissue. It includes general, unspecified, or acute nonsuppurative inflammation. Chronic nonsuppurative inflammation is periapical granuloma. Suppurative inflammation is periapical abscess.

name: intrahepatic biliary papillomatosis
definition: A non-invasive, papillary epithelial neoplasm that arises from the epithelium of the intrahepatic bile ducts.

name: inflammatory liposarcoma
definition: A rare morphologic variant of well differentiated liposarcoma occurring most often in the retroperitoneum. It is characterized by the presence of a predominant inflammatory infiltrate composed of lymphoplasmacytic aggregates.

name: meningeal melanomatosis
definition: A meningeal melanoma with secondary diffuse meningeal spread. (WHO)
parents: primary melanoma of the central nervous system

name: adult pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma
definition: An aggressive rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in adults. The neoplasm is characterized by the presence of bizarre round, spindle, and polygonal cells. Clinical presentation includes a rapidly enlarging painful mass usually in the lower extremities.

name: chronic rhinitis
definition: Chronic inflammation of the nasal cavity mucosa. It may lead to post-nasal drip resulting in chronic sore throat and chronic cough.

name: ureter tuberculosis
definition: A tuberculosis that involves the ureter.

name: anterior urethra cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm that affects the portion of the urethra that is close to the outside of the body.

name: synovial angioma
synonyms: hemangioma of layer of synovial tissue
definition: A rare hemangioma arising from synovium lining surfaces.

name: intratubular embryonal carcinoma
synonyms: stage 0 testicular embryonal carcinoma aJCC v6
stage 0 testicular embryonal carcinoma aJCC v6 and v7
stage 0 testicular embryonal carcinoma aJCC v7
definition: Stage 0 includes: pTis, N0, M0, S0. pTis: Intratubular germ cell neoplasia (carcinoma in situ). N0: regional lymph node metastasis. M0: No distant metastasis. S0: Marker study levels within normal limits. (AJCC 6th and 7th eds.)

name: adult epithelioid sarcoma
definition: An epithelioid sarcoma occurring in adults.

name: infectious peritonitis
definition: Inflammation of the peritoneum due to infection by bacteria or fungi. Causes include liver disease, perforation of the gastrointestinal tract or biliary tract, and peritoneal dialysis. Patients usually present with abdominal pain and tenderness, fever, chills, and nausea and vomiting. It is an emergency medical condition that requires prompt medical attention and treatment.

name: clear cell squamous cell skin carcinoma
synonyms: clear cell squamous cell carcinoma of skin
clear cell squamous cell carcinoma of the skin
clear cell squamous cell skin carcinoma
definition: A squamous cell carcinoma of the skin with a prominent clear cell component.

name: thyroid gland atypical follicular adenoma
definition: A thyroid gland adenoma with increased cellularity and nuclear atypia. There is no capsular or vascular invasion. The clinical course is benign.

name: scabies
synonyms: Sarcoptes scabiei caused disease or disorder
definition: A contagious skin infection that is caused by the burrowing parasitic mite, Sarcoptes scabiei, and is characterized by intense itching and small, raised red spots in the area of the mite burrows.

name: mixed endometrial stromal and smooth muscle tumor
synonyms: mixed endometrial stromal and smooth muscle neoplasm
definition: A benign or malignant mesenchymal neoplasm of the uterine corpus. Representative examples include leiomyoma, leiomyosarcoma, and endometrial stromal sarcoma.
children_sample: uterine corpus perivascular epithelioid cell tumor

name: lymph node palisaded myofibroblastoma
synonyms: palisaded myofibroblastoma of the lymph node
definition: A myofibroblastoma arising from the inguinal lymph nodes. It is characterized by the presence of nuclear palisading.

name: non-ossifying fibromyxoid tumor
definition: A rare soft tissue tumor of uncertain lineage characterized by the presence of neoplastic spindle to round cells forming cords in a fibromyxoid stroma. Metaplastic bone formation is not present.

name: early invasive cervical adenocarcinoma
definition: A cervical adenocarcinoma with minimal stromal invasion. The risk of local lymph node metastasis is insignificant and the prognosis is excellent.

name: sclerosing adenosis of breast
definition: Breast adenosis characterized by the proliferation of acini, a lobulated architectural pattern, and stromal sclerosis. The luminal epithelial and myopepithelial cells are preserved. Microcalcifications and foci of apocrine metaplasia may be present.

name: auditory system cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the auditory system
grandparents: disease by body system or component

name: perineural angioma
definition: A hemangioma arising from perineural tissues.

name: microglandular adenosis of breast
definition: A rare variant of breast adenosis characterized by the proliferation of small round glands in a collagenous stroma. The epithelial cells are cuboidal and there are no myopepithelial cells present. There is no evidence of atypia.

name: childhood choriocarcinoma of the ovary
definition: A non-gestational choriocarcinoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

name: intestinal variant cervical mucinous adenocarcinoma
definition: A cervical mucinous adenocarcinoma that resembles the large intestinal adenocarcinoma.

name: endocervical type cervical mucinous adenocarcinoma
definition: A cervical mucinous adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells that resemble those of the endocervix.

name: aortic malignant tumor
definition: A cancer that involves the aorta.

name: epithelioid malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
synonyms: epithelioid malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
malignant epithelioid neoplasm of peripheral nerve sheath
malignant epithelioid neoplasm of the peripheral nerve sheath
malignant epithelioid peripheral nerve sheath neoplasm
malignant epithelioid peripheral nerve sheath tumor
malignant epithelioid peripheral nerve sheath tumour
malignant epithelioid tumor of peripheral nerve sheath
definition: A rare variant of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor composed predominantly or exclusively of epithelioid cells.
grandparents: tumor of cranial and spinal nerves

name: pseudoglandular variant testicular seminoma
definition: A morphologic variant of testicular seminoma characterized by the presence of seminoma cells arranged in pseudoglandular patterns and few lymphocytes.

name: cervical adenosquamous carcinoma, glassy cell variant
synonyms: cervical adenosquamous carcinoma, glassy cell variant
related_synonyms: glassy cell adenocarcinoma of the uterine cervix
glassy cell carcinoma of the cervix
definition: A poorly differentiated variant of adenosquamous carcinoma that arises from the cervix. It is characterized by the presence of large malignant cells with ground glass cytoplasm and stromal eosinophilic infiltrates.

name: enteric pattern testicular yolk sac tumor
synonyms: testicular yolk Sac tumor, enteric pattern
definition: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of immature glands.

name: chordoid meningioma
definition: A WHO grade II, usually recurring meningioma characterized by the predominance of tissues that are histologically similar to chordoma.

name: adult malignant schwannoma
synonyms: adult malignant neoplasm of peripheral nerve sheath
adult malignant neoplasm of the peripheral nerve sheath
adult malignant peripheral nerve sheath neoplasm
adult malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
adult malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumour
adult malignant tumor of peripheral nerve sheath
definition: A malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor occurring during adulthood.
grandparents: tumor of cranial and spinal nerves

name: lumbar plexus neoplasm
definition: A neoplasm (disease) that involves the lumbar nerve plexus.

name: reticular pattern testicular yolk sac tumor
synonyms: testicular yolk Sac tumor, microcystic pattern
testicular yolk Sac tumor, reticular pattern
definition: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of a meshwork of small vacuolated cells resulting in a honeycomb appearance.

name: adult type testicular granulosa cell tumor
synonyms: adult type testicular granulosa cell tumor
definition: A rare sex cord-stromal tumor that arises from the testis in adults. Gynecomastia is present in approximately a quarter of the patients. Several morphologic patterns have been identified and include insular, gyriform, trabecular, pseudosarcomatous, and solid. Metastases occur in approximately twenty percent of the cases.

name: cork-handlers' disease
definition: An extrinsic allergic alveolitis caused by inhalation of cork dust containing the antigens produced by the fungus Penicillium glabrum. The symptoms include dyspnea, wheezing cough, fever and asthenia.

name: malignant cornea melanoma
definition: A melanoma within the cornea of the eye.

name: Meckel diverticulitis
definition: Inflammation of a congenital diverticulum of the lower intestine.

name: microinvasive cervical squamous cell carcinoma
synonyms: early invasive cervical squamous cell carcinoma
definition: A cervical squamous cell carcinoma with minimal stromal invasion. The risk of lymph node metastasis is low.

name: childhood kidney angiomyolipoma
definition: An angiomyolipoma occurring in childhood.

name: kidney angiomyolipoma
definition: An angiomyolipoma arising from the kidney.
grandparents: neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation

name: carcinoma arising in nasal papillomatosis
definition: A rare squamous cell carcinoma that either arises from or is associated with the presence of inverted papilloma in the nose.

name: congenital fibrosarcoma
definition: A fibrosarcoma that occurs in infants. It shares identical morphologic features with adult fibrosarcoma but carries the t(12;15)(p13;q25) translocation that results in ETV6-NTRK3 gene fusion. It usually affects the superficial and deep soft tissues of the extremities. The prognosis is generally much more favorable than for adult fibrosarcoma, and it rarely metastasizes.

name: thyroid gland macrofollicular adenoma
definition: A thyroid gland adenoma composed of large size follicles.

name: malignant glandular tumor of peripheral nerve sheath
synonyms: glandular malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
glandular malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumour
malignant glandular neoplasm of peripheral nerve sheath
malignant glandular neoplasm of the peripheral nerve sheath
malignant glandular peripheral nerve sheath neoplasm
malignant glandular peripheral nerve sheath tumor
malignant glandular peripheral nerve sheath tumour
definition: A variant of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor characterized by the presence of glandular epithelium.
grandparents: tumor of cranial and spinal nerves

name: follicular infundibulum tumor
synonyms: basal cell hamartoma with follicular differentiation

name: retinal melanoma
definition: A melanoma affecting the retinal portion of the eye. --2003

name: breast apocrine carcinoma in situ
synonyms: apocrine carcinoma in situ of breast
apocrine carcinoma in situ of the breast
definition: A ductal breast carcinoma in situ, characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells with apocrine differentiation.

name: physiological polycythemia
definition: Polycythemia that is not pathologic.

name: thyroid malformation
definition: An anatomic abnormality of the thyroid gland.

name: intestinal obstruction
definition: Blockage of the normal flow of the intestinal contents within the bowel.

name: postgastrectomy syndrome
definition: Sequelae of gastrectomy from the second week after operation on. Include recurrent or anastomotic ulcer, postprandial syndromes (dumping syndrome and late postprandial hypoglycemia), disordered bowel action, and nutritional deficiencies.

name: ileus
definition: Decrease in peristalsis in the absence of a mechanical bowel obstruction.

name: paralytic ileus
definition: An ileus caused by abdominal or pelvic surgery, infections, disorders that affect the muscles and nerves, and medications. Signs and symptoms include those of intestinal obstruction.

name: brachial plexus neuropathy from injury
definition: A brachial plexus neuropathy caused by an injury in the brachial plexus network of nerves.

name: intestinal volvulus
definition: Twisting of a loop of bowel that results in intestinal obstruction.

name: cyclothymic disorder
definition: An affective disorder characterized by periods of depression and hypomania. These may be separated by periods of normal mood.

name: ariboflavinosis
definition: A dietary deficiency of riboflavin causing a syndrome chiefly marked by cheilitis, angular stomatitis, glossitis associated with a purplish red or magenta-colored tongue that may show fissures, corneal vascularization, dyssebacia, and anemia. (Dorland, 27th ed)
grandparents: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism
hpo_phenotypes: Decreased circulating vitamin B2 concentration [1/1 patients]
Elevated circulating fatty acylcarnitine concentration [1/1 patients]
Elevated urinary dicarboxylic acid level [1/1 patients]

name: pyridoxine deficiency anemia
definition: Deficiency of vitamin B6. It is usually caused by alcoholism, malabsorption, or as a side effect of medications. Signs and symptoms include stomatitis, glossitis, dermatitis, peripheral neuropathy, irritability, seizures, and anemia.

name: choline deficiency disease
definition: A condition produced by a deficiency of choline in animals. Choline is known as a lipotropic agent because it has been shown to promote the transport of excess fat from the liver under certain conditions in laboratory animals. Combined deficiency of choline (included in the B vitamin complex) and all other methyl group donors causes liver cirrhosis in some animals. Unlike compounds normally considered as vitamins, choline does not serve as a cofactor in enzymatic reactions. (From Saunders Dictionary & Encyclopedia of Laboratory Medicine and Technology, 1984)

name: corneal ulcer
definition: Area of epithelial tissue loss from corneal surface; associated with inflammatory cells in the cornea and anterior chamber.
grandparents: disease by developmental or physiological process

name: retinoschisis
definition: An inherited or acquired disorder characterized by splitting of the retina into two layers. It results in loss of vision.

name: retinal degeneration
definition: Degeneration of the retina.

name: rheumatic myocarditis
definition: Inflammation of the myocardium in acute rheumatic heart disease.

name: transient retinal arterial occlusion
definition: A partial, temporary occlusion of the retinal artery.

name: polyhydramnios
definition: An excess quantity of amniotic fluid in the amniotic sac as compared to normal values. Typically associated with an amniotic fluid index (AFI) of greater than or equal to 25 cm or a single maximum vertical pocket (MVP) of greater than 8 cm.

name: rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease
definition: A group of lung problems related to rheumatoid arthritis.

name: night blindness
definition: Inability to see clearly in dim light.

name: impetigo herpetiformis
definition: An impetigo that is characterized as a form of severe pustular psoriasis occurring in pregnancy.
grandparents: skin disease caused by bacterial infection

name: impetigo
definition: A contagious bacterial cutaneous infection that affects children and is usually caused by Staphylococcus aureus. It usually presents in the face with honey colored scabs.
parents: skin disease caused by bacterial infection

name: Bartholin duct cyst
definition: Distension of the Bartholin gland duct caused by an accumulation of mucus in the duct, usually as a result of obstruction of the gland duct orifice.
grandparents: disease by body system or component

name: cor pulmonale
definition: Hypertrophy and dilation of the right ventricle of the heart that is caused by pulmonary hypertension. This condition is often associated with pulmonary parenchymal or vascular diseases, such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and pulmonary embolism.

name: pulmonary embolism and infarction
definition: Localized necrosis of lung tissue caused by obstruction of the arterial blood supply, most often due to pulmonary embolism.

name: acute cor pulmonale
definition: A form of acute right heart failure produced by a sudden increase in resistance to blood flow in the pulmonary circulation.

name: barbiturate abuse
definition: A substance abuse that involves the recurring use of barbiturate drugs despite negative consequences.

name: ulcer of lower limbs
definition: Ulcer of lower limbs is a chronic ulcer of skin where the ulcer is not a decubitus ulcer.

name: collagenopathy
grandparents: disease by body system or component
children_sample: multiple epiphyseal dysplasia due to collagen 9 anomaly

name: Hodgkin's lymphoma, lymphocytic-histiocytic predominance
definition: A subtype of classical Hodgkin lymphoma with scattered Hodgkin and Reed-Sternberg cells and a nodular or less often diffuse cellular background consisting of small lymphocytes and with an absence of neutrophils and eosinophils. (WHO, 2008)

name: vallecula cancer
definition: A cancer involving a epiglottic vallecula.

name: oropharynx cancer
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of junctional region of oropharynx
malignant neoplasm of lateral wall of oropharynx
malignant neoplasm of posterior wall of oropharynx
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the oropharynx.

name: herpes simplex infectious disease
definition: A group of acute infections caused by herpes simplex virus type 1 or type 2 that is characterized by the development of one or more small fluid-filled vesicles with a raised erythematous base on the skin or mucous membrane. It occurs as a primary infection or recurs due to a reactivation of a latent infection. (Dorland, 27th ed.)

name: soft palate cancer
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of the soft palate
malignant tumor of the soft palate
definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the soft palate.

name: malignant histiocytosis
definition: Distinctive neoplastic disorders of histiocytes. Included are malignant neoplasms of macrophages and dendritic cells.

name: acute intestinal ischemia
definition: Ischemia of the intestine that is rapid in onset.

name: chronic monocytic leukemia
definition: Form of leukemia characterized by an uncontrolled proliferation of the myeloid lineage and their precursors (myeloid progenitor cells) in the bone marrow and other sites.

name: upper gum cancer
synonyms: cancer of gingiva of upper jaw
malignant gingiva of upper jaw neoplasm
malignant neoplasm of gingiva of upper jaw
definition: A cancer involving a gingiva of upper jaw.

name: herpetic whitlow
definition: A painful blister of the periungual skin that is caused by herpes simplex virus type 1 or 2.

name: recurrent hypersomnia
definition: Disorders characterized by hypersomnolence during normal waking hours that may impair cognitive functioning. Subtypes include primary hypersomnia disorders (e.g., idiopathic hypersomnolence; narcolepsy; and kleine-levin syndrome) and secondary hypersomnia disorders where excessive somnolence can be attributed to a known cause (e.g., drug affect, mental disorders, and sleep apnea syndrome). (From J Neurol Sci 1998 Jan 8;153(2):192-202; Thorpy, Principles and Practice of Sleep Medicine, 2nd ed, p320)

name: diplegia of upper limb
grandparents: disease by body system or component

name: measles
synonyms: Measles morbillivirus caused disease or disorder
definition: A highly contagious viral infection caused by the measles virus. Symptoms appear 8-12 days after exposure and include a rash, cough, fever and muscle pains that can last 4-7 days. Measles vaccines are available to provide prophylaxis, usually combined with mumps and rubella vaccines (MMR).

name: Hodgkin's lymphoma, lymphocytic depletion
synonyms: adult lymphocyte depleted classical Hodgkin lymphoma
definition: A diffuse subtype of classical Hodgkin lymphoma which is rich in Hodgkin and Reed-Sternberg cells and/or depleted in non-neoplastic lymphocytes. (WHO, 2008)

name: upper lip cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the upper lip.

name: uvula cancer
definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the palatine uvula.

name: phlebitis

name: hepatopulmonary syndrome
definition: Hepatopulmonary syndrome (HPS) is a lung disease characterized by widening of arteries and veins (dilatation) in the lungs in people who have chronic liver disease. Because of the dilated vases, the workload of the heart increases and the blood pumped to the body does not have enough oxygen, leading to a decreased level of oxygen in the blood (hypoxemia). The normal diameter of the lung vessels ranges between 8 and 15 μm whereas when in HPS rises to between 15 and 500 μm. While many people with HPS don't have any obvious problems, the main reported symptom is shortness of breath (dyspnea) that is worse when standing or sitting up, and is relieved when lying down (platypnea). Symptoms related to chronic liver disease (generally cirrhosis) include small red spots on the skin (spider angiomas) and abnormal vascular dilatations. Some other symptoms that have been described are infections in the brain (brain abscesses), brain bleeding and an increased number of red blood cells in the blood (polycythemia). There is currently no effective medication for HPS. Oxygen therapy may improve the breathing in some cases. Liver transplant is an efficient treatment which improves the symptoms, even in severe cases.
